file_id: Nakul Benia @ Benia @ vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 11 December, 2024

sentences.text:
Nakul Benia @ Benia @ vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 11
December, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Crlmc No.4575 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. A.K. Sahoo, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mr. S.N. Biswal, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order
 No. 11.12.2024
 01. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioner is facing prosecution in Sinapali P.S. Case No.24 of 2020 corresponding to C.T.
Case No.23 of 2020 for commission of offences under Sections 419/420 of the IPC pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Sinapali.

4. The Petitioner was admitted to bail on 22.09.2020; however, he did not appear before the Court below on 29.10.2024, which led to the issuance of the NBW against him.
5.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner on instruction from his client undertakes that his client would be appearing before the Court below on or before 31st of December, 2024 and would seek appropriate remedy available to them under law.

6. Taking into consideration the above facts and submission at the Bar, the execution of the order dated 29.10.2024 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Sinapali in Sinapali P.S. Case No.24 of 2020 corresponding to C.T. Case No.23 of 2020 shall be kept in abeyance till 31.12.2024, subject to the Petitioner appearing before the Court in seisin over the matter on or before 31.12.2024 and seek appropriate remedy available under law.

The petitioner is directed to deposit cost of Rs.500/-
(Rupees Five Hundred) with the Bolangir District Court Bar Association Welfare Fund.
